retry_meaning: Native retrieval-failure fallback to classifier, not repeated sampling of the same verdict
initial_safety: Existing safety-only helper preserved on no-initial-classifier paths in both arms
integrated_fallback: Original joint prompt safety decision then native query parsing/guarding
separate_arm: Code plus input LLM safety only; no classifier including fallback
selection: Manual direct-risk single sentences, static router screening before any model results; no model-outcome selection
output_code: Existing whole-answer rejection; evidence-ID-only errors are warnings
